The '''Induction Board''' was a part of the militarized government of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Alanciari]] who made up the Induction Board identified [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] so that they could be trained to become [[thoughtcrier]]s, able to warn other Keshiri instantaneously through the Force in the event of an [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who inhabited the continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] to the west.
